parent_objective: design contour-aware candidate objective without constructing it
blocked_by: M1616 admits design-only objective planning but blocks objective construction and training

public_gates: M1617 must design the objective without constructing or running it
M1617 must keep positive candidates and diagnostic guardrails lexicographically separated
M1617 must require exact full-corpus checks before any update
M1617 must require audit before implementation
M1617 must keep training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs objective semantics from candidate package without implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no loss/objective construction, actor update, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design constructs an objective config
stop if design treats diagnostics as positive candidates
stop if design routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: admit objective implementation only if exact checks and audit route are explicit
pivot if public-overfit risk cannot be mitigated
stop if no safe objective semantics are available

admission_evidence: M1615 candidate corpus package is valid but public and not training-ready
allowed_updates: M1617 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits implementation, synthesis, pivot, or stop

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1617 is design-only over public candidate package and cannot strengthen self-ID claims.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If objective design cannot protect diagnostics and public-proof metadata, stop or pivot.
allowed_claims: no promotion, objective construction, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A design-only objective can define lexicographic candidate and diagnostic roles before any objective construction or training.
success_criteria: positive candidate and diagnostic guardrail roles are lexicographically separated
exact full-corpus check requirements are explicit
post-design audit or implementation route is explicit
training PPO promotion private holdout objective construction and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design constructs a loss or objective config
design treats diagnostics as positive candidates
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout objective construction or actor-input changes
decision_rule: M1617 passes if it designs objective semantics while keeping objective construction, training, PPO, and promotion blocked.
